items.claim: D-Rod is past his prime and has looked poor in his recent fights.
items.quote: I think D-Rod's done. I think Drod's washed. I' I've thought he's looked bad his last like five or six fights.

items.claim: D-Rod's recent win streak came against opponents who were washed or compromised.
items.quote: Ponzibio who's completely washed. Morona who's completely washed and Kevin Holland who showed the fight highly compromised.

items.claim: Eros Medic possesses tons of power.
items.quote: Tons and tons of power. I think he knocks out D-Rod in the first or second round.
